# Bryan Ferrando

> Portfolio of Bryan Ferrando, full-stack developer: apprentice at Magellan (MeTS branch, public sector), Epitech student and creator of FerrLabs. The site is bilingual: French at /, English at /en.

## Pages

- [Accueil (français)](https://bryan-ferrando.fr/): hero, selected projects, tech stack, journey timeline and contact form
- [Home (English)](https://bryan-ferrando.fr/en): same content in English

## Projects

- [FerrLabs](https://ferrlabs.com): the tool suite Bryan builds (FerrFlow, FerrVault, FerrTrack, FerrGrowth, FerrFleet, FerrLens, FerrGames)
- [FerrFlow](https://ferrflow.com): universal semantic versioning for monorepos, written in Rust
- [FerrGames](https://ferrgames.com): multiplayer browser party games, real-time Rust servers
- [LFSX](https://lfsx.dev): fast, lightweight, secure Git LFS server in Rust
- [IdleWarden](https://idlewarden.com): extensible automation platform for idle games on Windows
- [Archego](https://archego.fr): complete client web platform with a Rust backend

## Contact

- [GitHub](https://github.com/BryanFRD)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryan-ferrando/)

## API

- GET https://bryan-ferrando.fr/api/projects: the projects catalog as JSON, with French and English descriptions
